name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2024 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2024 record supports: the technique tables of CISA and partner advisories AA24-038A (Volt Typhoon), AA24-060B (Ivanti), AA24-131A (Black Basta), AA24-190A (APT40), AA24-242A (RansomHub) and AA24-249A (Unit 29155), the AA24-109A (Akira) live table, AA24-057A, AA24-046A, AA24-207A and AA24-290A, Microsoft's Midnight Blizzard guidance, Mandiant's UNC5537 report, Volexity's Ivanti and Nearest Neighbor reports, the XZ Utils disclosure, and campaign C0041. Revoked ids printed by the advisories (T1562.001, T1562.004, T1070.001) are shown under their v20.0 successors from data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2024.md. Scores: 100 an opened source or ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
